title: Balanced Diet Lowers Biological Age in Older Adults in Four Weeks
seoTitle: Diet Lowers Biological Age in 4 Weeks
subtitle: Shifting the balance of fats, carbohydrates, and animal protein showed positive effects
excerpt: Older adults who adjusted the proportion of fats, carbohydrates, and animal protein in their diet showed signs of decreased biological age in just four weeks.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
A recent study has demonstrated that older adults can show signs of a reduced biological age after just four weeks of dietary changes. Participants modified the balance between fats, carbohydrates, and animal protein in their diets.

Most Striking Results

Among the different dietary profiles tested, the strongest result was observed in individuals who followed an omnivorous diet with a lower fat content and a higher proportion of carbohydrates.

Implications

These findings suggest that adjustments to the macronutrient composition of the diet can influence markers associated with biological age, offering a short-term dietary strategy to potentially improve health indicators in older populations.
